title: SpongeBob SquarePants - 1x20 - Culture Shock - F U N

lines.text: SUB BY : DENI AUROR@ https://aurorarental.blogspot.com/ Are you ready, kids?

* who lives in a pineapple under the sea? * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * absorbent and yellow and porous is he. * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * if nautical nonsense be something you wish... * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * then drop on the deck and flop like a fish. * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * ready? Spongebob Squarepants! * * Spongebob Squarepants!
If a free salad bar doesn't bring in customers What will?!
There's going to be some changes around here.
Spongebob, cater to his every whim And don't screw this one up.
Here at the krusty krab, you are the Captain And i am your cabin boy.
You just say the word And i will throw myself in the brig.
All i wanted was change for the pay phone.
As you may have noticed, profits are way down this month.
We need a gimmick to bring in customers.
Do you lubbers have any ideas?
I've got one-- A free pair of socks with every purchase.
Oh! Oh! Oh! Oh! Oh! Oh!
I know! I know! I know!
Everyone who shows up with a mouthful of clams Gets a free drink.
Well, uh... i was thinking More along the lines of live entertainment.
No, wait, a talent show With your host-- Me!
Oh, this is the moment i've...
I mean, we've been dreaming of.
Think of it, Mister Krabs You will be responsible for bringing culture Into this cultural wasteland We call bikini bottom.
And not to mention the money.
And i can see it now.
Your daughter, pearl-- Her name up in lights.
Make my little girl a star.
Hey, Squidward, what time am i going on?
When am i going on the show?
What talent could you possibly possess?
No one, not even your parents, would want to see that.
What the people want is culture, not dancing bubbles.
I'm going to come up with the most cultured act ever!
Phew! The only culture that guy has is in his tennis shoes.
Ha, ha! Tennis shoes-- Ha, ha!
We are live at the krusty krab talent show Featuring the finest talent...
They are going to be so proud!
Hello, i'm Mister Krabs, and i like money.
Now, you may be thinking This is your one shot at the big time.
Hey, squid, how about this for the show?
No one is going to want to see you engorge yourself.
Please, Squidward, let me be in the show.
So, you really want to be in the show?
Okay, you get to mop up afterwards.
Now, will you stop bugging me?
So, this is what it feels like-- The big time.
With this mop, i shape my destiny!
Good evening, and welcome To the first annual Squidward tentacles talent show Sponsored by the krusty krab Home of the krabby patty Because no one else would give it a home.
Our next act is living proof that nepotism is alive and well.
My little girl is finally a star!
Hey, Squidward, listen, what do you think?
When i mop Should i go forward and back?
No, no, wait-- Side to side.
He has such a way with words.
If he doesn't hurry it up We're not going to have enough time for the best act-- Me!
Squidward, should i use mr. Cleanser or dr. Clean?
I, the amazing plankton With the use of prestidigitation Will make a krabby patty disappear before your very eyes.
First, i'll need a volunteer from the audience.
Get out! Get off the stage!
Now, now, don't you worry, Mister Krabs.
I've saved the best for last-- You'll see.
For your sake, i hope you're right.
And now, ladies and gentlemen The moment you've all been waiting for.
We've saved the best for last.
Put your hands together for the incomparable Squidward!
I'm losing money on this deal.
No talent! No talent! No talent! No talent!
Hey, Squidward, can i go on now?
Who ever knew he had such talent?
I'll be needing another wheelbarrow For next week's show!
Ah, the krusty krab-- Everyone enjoying their krabby patties.
Can you spot her, mr. Squidward?
There appears to be a krabby patty-Napping in progress.
There can be only one culprit...
He's finally stolen me secret recipe.
Perhaps not, monsieur krabs, for it's...
Have you seen a krabby patty?
One time i saw this magician And he did this thing, and...
Anyway, and then he told us "If you believe in yourself "And with a tiny pinch of magic All your dreams can come true."
Yes, and after all these years I thought i was the master of torture.
But that. That just wasn't fair.
I don't want the secret recipe anyway.
I guess my restaurant will never be as good as the krusty krab.
You don't know what it's like to be a loser.
How does it feel To be the most hated thing In bikini bottom, plankton?
It hurts, doesn't it? I know.
Yeah, and for running you out We're going to make this kid Honorary town rookie of the day.
* for he's a jolly good rookie * * for he's a jolly good rookie * for he's a jolly good rookie... * I bet if he had just one friend he wouldn't be such a meanie.
Our special today is chum... balaya.
Haven't you degraded me Enough for one day?
I want you to come out and play with me.
You know how to induce thermonuclear fusion?
No, but i like to go...
How long must i suffer this?
You're not letting him leave, are you?
This is the perfect opportunity for revenge.
Befriend the sponge bath Then, when the time is just right, take the krabby patty!
Get moving, genius, don't let him get away!
All right, Spongebob, i'll play your little game.
Last one to the fields Is a rotten clam!
So, i get the big net And you get the little net.
What happens after we eat them?
You don't eat them, you catch them, like this.
* la, la, la, la-La, la, la, la, la-La. * Like that.
Then you throw them back-- Watch out for stingers.
All knees will bow to plankton.
It's not about winning, it's about fun.

Let me spell it for you: * "f" is for friends who do stuff together * * "u" is for you and me * "n" is for anywhere and anytime at all * * down here in the deep blue sea. * * "f" is fire that burns down the whole town. * * "u" is for uranium... bombs * * "n" is for no survivors when you... * Plankton, those things aren't what fun is all about.
Now, do it like this: * "f" is for friends who...
* "f" is for friends who do stuff together * * "u" is for you and me... * Try it!
* "n" is for anywhere and anytime at all * * down here in the deep blue sea. * Wait, i don't understand this-- I feel all tingly inside.
No, that's how you're supposed to feel.
Well, i like it-- Let's do it again!
* "f" is for frolic through all the flowers * * "u" is for ukulele * "n" is for nose picking, sharing gum and sand licking * * here with my best buddy.
And after that We frolicked through the flowers and then we...
The really fun part was when we...
You can't rush these things, you know.
I haven't seen plankton for a while.
I forgot this is a no-Friends zone.
May i speak to you in private?
You won't mind if i set this here, will you?
What's this all about, Mister Krabs?
He's a thief-- Look at the lust in his eye, he's...
Why can't you just accept our friendship?
Argh, you must be hungry After that long walk over here.
Oh, yes, but i'm saving my appetite For some popcorn at the movies.
We've had enough Of your little tests, Mister Krabs.
Come on, plankton, let's get out of here.
And maybe scallops will fly out of my pants!
Hang on there, laddie, i'm a-Comin'!
Hey, bubble bass, you're sitting on my friend.
Reach into his pocket now and take what he's got!
Tell me what you see here.
How can you not see it?
But we sang the fun song.
I think i'm going to be sick.
How long were you planning on doing this?!
I tricked you to get the krabby patty!
But then you showed me friendship...
That's all i ever really wanted.
Being evil is too much fun!
Oh, darling, i knew nothing would ever tear us apart.
Don't you know what's behind these screens?
I'm sorry, Mister Krabs I thought plankton had changed.
No friendship can withstand The allure of a krabby patty.
Now, let's go back to the krusty krab And have a fresh one, on me!
